name: License desktop manager (Python + MongoDB)
description: Desktop license SCRUD client for MongoDB Atlas: search, create, read, update, and delete software license records from a PySide6 operator UI.
longDescription: A Python desktop application for managing a central license database hosted on MongoDB Atlas. Operators connect via environment-configured Atlas credentials and perform full SCRUD workflows: search and filter licenses, generate structured keys, view records in paginated tables, update status/expiry/device limits, and delete entries with confirmation. A dedicated data layer wraps PyMongo with connection pooling, indexes, typed models, and curated Atlas connectivity errors. CSV export, device HWID tracking, timezone-aware timestamps, and packaged Windows builds support day-to-day licensing operations without exposing a public admin API.
features: License SCRUD: search, create, read, update, and delete against MongoDB Atlas
Structured license records with status, type, expiry, product, and customer fields
License key generation with validation before persistence
Paginated, sortable table UI with multi-field search and filters
Device HWID registration and max-device enforcement
PyMongo data layer with connection pooling, indexes, and typed models
Environment-based Atlas URI configuration (no secrets in source control)
CSV export and operator tooling for reporting and hand-offs
Curated connection diagnostics for Atlas DNS and network failures
highlights: Central Atlas-backed license database managed from a secure desktop client
Clear separation between PySide6 UI and MongoDB data-access layer
Search-first SCRUD workflows for high-volume license operations
challenges: Licensing data is sensitive and Atlas connectivity must stay reliable on variable operator networks.
solutions: Environment-gated credentials, validated writes, indexed queries, and user-facing Atlas error guidance before any destructive action.
security: MongoDB Atlas credentials loaded from environment or encrypted local config, never committed
Input validation before every create and update operation
Parameterized PyMongo access with least-privilege Atlas database users
Exports omit internal identifiers when shared outside the operations team
